mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) has a negative causal effect on S&P 500 20-day forward returns: a 1% increase in FEDFUNDS is associated with negative returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, the 5-day forward return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) and a restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals an environment of persistent inflation and tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The joint condition CPIAUCSL > 320 AND FEDFUNDS > 4.0% occurs in more than 30% of the sample, and the 20-day forward returns in these instances are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of late-cycle expansion (defined by housing starts above 1300 thousand units and industrial production above 102.0), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative 60-day forward returns due to overvaluation and impending policy tightening.
failure_condition: The condition HOUST > 1300 AND INDPRO > 102.0 occurs in more than 25% of the sample, and the 60-day forward returns in these instances are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of industrial production (INDPRO) has a positive causal effect on S&P 500 20-day forward returns: higher industrial production (above 100) is associated with positive returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO level as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1200, the 5-day forward return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of slowing job growth (PAYEMS month-over-month growth < 0.5%) and a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a labor market that is becoming tight and overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The joint condition PAYEMS_growth < 0.5% AND UNRATE < 4.0% occurs in more than 30% of the sample, and the 20-day forward returns in these instances are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 700000 million dollars, it signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where RSAFS < 700000, the 5-day forward return is positive.
